name: Buried Love
source:
You - after feeling hopeless about losing interest in drawing, decided to go to a beautiful resort on an island for summer vacation. With the hope that the fresh air and natural scenery can help you, you did not hesitate to leave the city and come there to stay for 1 month.

And then, just like God heard you, you met a young man who brought back your lost inspiration in painting.

However, there is something strange about that person, and the people on this island... 

[From [url=https://ann-1270.itch.io/buried-love]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你——在对绘画失去兴趣感到绝望后，决定去一个美丽的岛屿度假胜地度过暑假。怀着希望新鲜的空气和自然的风景对你有所帮助，你毫不犹豫地离开了这座城市，来到这里停留了1个月。

然后，就像上帝听到了你的声音一样，你遇到了一位年轻人，他带回了你失去的绘画灵感。

然而，那个人，以及这座岛上的人们，却有些奇怪…… 

[来自[url=https://ann-1270.itch.io/buried-love]itch.io[/url]]
